description: For any membership relation, if R has exactly the members of A that do not belong to themselves, then R does not belong to A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.AxiomaticSetTheory.russell_not_mem.{u} {α : Type u} (M : α → α → Prop) (A R : α)
  (hR : ∀ (x : α), M x R ↔ M x A ∧ ¬M x x) : ¬M R A
